metaTitle: Land Rover Engine Failure Repair | Land Rover Garage
metaDescription: Professional Land Rover engine failure assessment, diagnosis and repair. Full strip-down inspection, bore scope analysis and comprehensive rebuild service.
lede: Full professional assessment, diagnosis and repair for failed Land Rover engines across the full model range.

blocks.html: When a Land Rover engine fails, a structured specialist assessment is required before any repair work begins. Our process is designed to identify the exact cause of failure, document the full scope of damage, and present clear repair options with fixed pricing.

We assess engines from the full Land Rover range, including [Defender](/defender-engines), [Discovery](/discovery-engines), [Range Rover](/landrover-range-rover-tdv6-engines), [Range Rover Sport](/range-rover-sport-engines), [Range Rover Velar](/range-rover-velar-engines), [Evoque](/range-rover-evoque-engines) and [Freelander](/freelander-engines) models. Every assessment follows a documented workflow from vehicle reception through to detailed reporting.
All work is backed by our [12-month unlimited-mileage warranty](/landrover-engine-warranty).

steps.title: Vehicle Arrival & Consultation
steps.body: Your Land Rover arrives at our workshop (recovery arranged where needed). We record your vehicle details and your account of what happened.

steps.title: Preliminary Visual Inspection
steps.body: Engine bay, fluid levels and condition, visible damage, belts and hoses, underside inspection for leaks.

steps.title: Diagnostic Scan
steps.body: Specialist JLR SDD/TOPix diagnostic equipment reads fault codes and live data. Any stored freeze-frame data is analysed.

steps.title: Controlled Mechanical Tests
steps.body: Compression testing, leak-down testing, oil pressure testing and cooling system pressure testing where the engine can be cranked.

steps.title: Borescope Inspection
steps.body: Through injector or glow plug ports: cylinder walls, piston crowns and valves are inspected for damage.

steps.title: Oil Analysis
steps.body: Oil sampled for metallic particles, coolant contamination or fuel dilution. Oil filter inspected for debris.

steps.title: Strip-Down Inspection (where required)
steps.body: Engine removed, mounted on stand, systematically stripped. All internal components inspected and documented with photographs.

steps.title: Reporting & Quotation
steps.body: Detailed inspection report with photographs. Clear repair options and fixed-price quotation presented to you. Work begins on authorisation.

items.q: How do you diagnose a failed Land Rover engine?
items.a: We follow a structured multi-stage assessment: customer consultation, preliminary visual inspection, diagnostic scan with JLR SDD/TOPix equipment, compression and leak-down tests, borescope inspection of cylinder walls and pistons, oil analysis, and strip-down inspection where required. Every assessment is documented with photographs and a detailed inspection report.

items.q: Can you fix an engine that another garage has rebuilt unsuccessfully?
items.a: Yes. We regularly see vehicles that have had previous rebuilds that weren't completed to specification. We strip the engine fully, inspect every component, identify incorrectly fitted or substandard parts, and rebuild correctly to manufacturer specification. This includes verifying torque settings, component clearances, timing alignment, and oil gallery cleanliness.

items.q: How long does an engine failure assessment take?
items.a: Initial diagnosis including visual inspection, diagnostic scan and basic tests typically takes 1–2 hours. If a borescope inspection or strip-down inspection is required, this extends the assessment to 1–2 days in total. We provide a detailed inspection report and quotation before any repair work begins.

items.q: Do you offer engine rebuilds for Land Rover vehicles?
items.a: Yes. We rebuild Land Rover engines across the full model range including Defender, Discovery, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, Velar, Evoque and Freelander. Our rebuilds cover 4-cylinder, 6-cylinder and V8 engines, with full component replacement, machining where required, and comprehensive testing before the engine goes back in your vehicle.

items.q: What does the engine failure repair process include?
items.a: The full process includes vehicle reception and customer consultation, preliminary visual inspection, diagnostic scanning with specialist JLR equipment, controlled mechanical testing (compression, leak-down, oil pressure, cooling system pressure), borescope inspection, oil analysis, detailed strip-down inspection where required, and a full written report with photographs and repair options. Every rebuild includes new components, machining where required, and a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
